section.title: Introduction
section.para: Numeric extraction on the document pipeline combines temporal mentions, document-date election, money amounts, measured quantities, and optional document-dated currency conversion. A dateline elects the document date; money mentions carry normalized BigDecimal amounts and ISO currency codes; MoneyConversionAnnotator restates those amounts in one target currency as of that date.
All extractors are model-free: they scan the text once, without regular expressions, and every mention keeps the span it covers in the original text.

section.title: Temporal, money, and conversion
Quantities
section.para: QuantityAnnotator adds a quantity layer over the raw text, so it requires no other layer. A mention is a number with a percent marker or a unit token; a bare number is never a quantity, which also keeps money mentions out of this layer. Percentages are reported with the unit %, whether written as a sign or as the word percent. No unit conversion is performed: 2.5km keeps the value 2.5 and the unit km.
